name: physarum_maze
theme: a slime mold solving a rain-drenched spruce floor — across a rotting log that is its own crowded city, into the chrome-yellow plasmodium fan and one of its trunk veins, where the shuttle-streaming protoplasm is combed into parallel lanes; on through the nuclei and mitochondria adrift in the sol to the gel cortex's helical cables and the motor mesh that reverses the current, whose combed strands hand off to the Laniakea flow twenty-eight orders out; the fold home rhymes a second time, a galaxy's spiral becoming a storm spiral on an ocean-green world, and the rain-lashed ranges drop back to the forest floor

registers.name: forest_floor
registers.palette: sodden umber litter, pewter mist, moss chartreuse
registers.scene: a rain-drenched forest floor under old spruce, sodden russet needle mats and fallen cones covering the ground, moss-furred stones shouldering up through them, a long fallen spruce log crossing the middle distance, fern crowns crowding the hollows, rainwater beading on every surface, pewter mist threading the trunks beyond, at eye level among the ferns

registers.name: log_city
registers.palette: sooty charcoal bark, russet rot, ochre fungus shelves
registers.scene: the flank of a rotting spruce log, charcoal bark peeled back to sodden russet wood, tiers of bracket fungus shelving out in banded ochre fans, beetle galleries chewed into winding grooves under the loosened bark, herds of slate-blue springtails swarming the damp grain, a scarlet velvet mite crossing a moss cushion, cup lichen sprouting from the upper curve, chrome-yellow slime veins netted over the rot

registers.name: plasmodium_fan
registers.palette: chrome yellow and sulphur glow on umber wood
registers.scene: the outer front of a slime mold plasmodium on sodden wood, a chrome-yellow sheet of protoplasm scalloped into a fan, hundreds of veins branching backward from the rim into a combed net of loops and blind alleys, thicker trunk veins gleaming where they cross the grain, sulphur glow pooling at every junction, umber wood showing through the mesh, seen from an oblique vantage over the rot

registers.name: vein_channel
registers.palette: jade-translucent walls, sulphur cargo, smoke-grey shadow
registers.scene: inside one trunk vein of the plasmodium, a tube walled in translucent chartreuse gel, a braid of grainy protoplasm packed the length of it and combed into parallel streamlines, cargo granules strung in taut ranks through the braid, rings of thicker gel ribbing the wall, side branches opening off the tube and receding into a sulphur haze

registers.name: streaming_sol
registers.palette: chartreuse sol, sulphur granules, smoke-green gloom
registers.scene: the interior of the plasmodium's streaming cytoplasm, hundreds of milky nuclei suspended through a chartreuse sol, capsule mitochondria ribbed with inner folds set among them, glassy vacuoles further off, sulphur granules strewn in ranks that recede into a smoke-green gloom, everything combed into the same parallel lanes, viewed from within the current
registers.loop_target: milky nuclei and sulphur granules suspended in a chartreuse sol, combed into parallel lanes

registers.name: gel_cortex
registers.palette: pewter cables, chartreuse rims, olive void
registers.scene: the gel cortex woven at the vein wall, cables of twin helical ribbons twisted about one another and ranked away in every direction, shorter rods pinned across them where the cables meet, chartreuse rims glowing at every crossing, pewter sheen on the cable flanks, an olive void opening past the furthest ranks

registers.name: motor_mesh
registers.palette: graphite murk, sulphur sparks, chartreuse strands
registers.scene: the motor mesh that drives the stream, spindle-shaped filaments bristling with paired knobs, each knob hooked onto a twin-stranded helical ribbon drawn taut through the murk, every ribbon combed one way across the whole field, sulphur sparks flaring where knob meets ribbon, rank after rank of the same combed strands receding into graphite gloom

registers.name: laniakea_flow
registers.palette: gunmetal void, violet-blue streams, chartreuse cluster knots
registers.scene: the Laniakea flow, thousands of galaxies strung on combed streamlines that all lean toward one far watershed knot, filaments of cold violet-blue drawn taut across enormous voids, sheets of dimmer galaxies walling each void, chartreuse-gold knots blazing where the strands converge, the whole field combed one way into gunmetal distance

registers.name: spiral_galaxy
registers.palette: gold-green core, indigo arms, amber star knots
registers.scene: a spiral galaxy set in the void, two great arms wound out from a gold-green core, dust lanes cutting the inner curve of each arm, amber knots of newborn stars strung through the arms, a haze of far suns behind it, the disk one flat spiral seen at a tilt

registers.name: storm_world
registers.palette: ocean-green seas, pewter cloud spirals, violet shadow
registers.scene: an ocean-green planet seen from orbit, storm spirals set across half the globe, an olive continent shouldered under torn cloud, lightning caught in the anvil tops, the terminator curve cutting the far side into violet shadow, a thin rind of atmosphere glowing at the horizon

registers.name: rain_ranges
registers.palette: amber squall glow, smoke-grey rain, spruce-green ridges
registers.scene: a forested range under a rainstorm, ridge after ridge of spruce crowns furred in cloud, meltwater creeks braided down every gully, torn sheets of rain sweeping the valley, amber storm glow breaking through the squall onto the nearest slope, that slope near enough to pick out single crowns, seen from an oblique vantage low over the ridges

music_theme: a shuttle-streaming pulse dive — a breathy reed organ over a deep sub heartbeat, the low pulse reversing its weight with each scale the way the veins reverse, water textures thickening as the tube closes in, one broad hit on the fold from the motor mesh into the cosmic streamlines and a second as the galaxy becomes the storm spiral, easing back to rain and organ breath over the forest
